newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to sell 49 pct in Svyazinvest May, no date.
newsitem.headline: Russia to sell 49 pct in Svyazinvest May, no date.

text.p: The Russian government will sell 49 percent of telecoms holding company AO Svyazinvest in May, but no exact date has yet been set, officials said on Friday.
"The tender is scheduled for May," Chairman of the State Communications Committee Alexander Krupnov told a news conference.
In April President Boris Yeltsin signed a decree authorising the sale of the stake in Svyazinvest, which in turn has controlling stakes in 85 regional telecommunications companies.
The government is also transferring its 38 percent stake (51 percent of the voting shares) in long-distance operator Rostelekom to Svyazinvest.
"All the documents are ready, but the government has not yet set the date," a Svyazinvest official told Reuters.
He said the sale would be carried out in two parts -- 25 percent plus one share will be sold at a cash auction and 24 percent would be sold at an investment tender.
A previous attempt to tender 25 percent and one share on Svyazinvest to strategic foreign investors, won by Italy's Stet spa in late 1995, susequently fell through.
Svyazinvest has controlling stakes in 85 regional telecommunications companies.
